schema.items: Array of coverage records, one per distinct CVE / actor / campaign / incident / annual-report reported in any brief.

fields.key: Stable identifier — CVE ID, canonical actor name, campaign slug, incident slug, or annual-report slug
fields.type: cve | actor | campaign | incident | tool | vulnerability-trend | annual-report
fields.title: Short human title shown in briefs
fields.last_covered: ISO date of most recent appearance
fields.primary_source_url: URL of the primary source used at first coverage
fields.appearances: Array of {date, section, brief_path, delta_summary} records

items.title: Copy Fail — Linux kernel algif_aead LPE (ITW, KEV deadline 2026-05-15)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Active ITW exploitation confirmed; CISA KEV deadline 2026-05-15; deterministic 732-byte Python exploit; all Linux kernels 4.14-6.19.11 affected; container-to-host escalation risk. Deep dive in § 5.
UPDATE: Go and Rust exploit variants now publicly available; container-to-host escape vector validated by Kaspersky. KEV deadline 2026-05-15 unchanged.

items.title: cPanel/WHM authentication bypass — mass exploitation ongoing (KEV deadline 2026-05-21)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. CRLF injection auth bypass in cPanel/WHM; exploited since ~2026-02-23 (two months before patch); ~44,000 hosts likely compromised; Sorry ransomware and AdaptixC2 campaigns; CISA KEV 2026-04-30.

items.title: Progress MOVEit Automation — unauthenticated auth bypass (CVSS 9.8)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Critical unauthenticated auth bypass on MOVEit Automation backend port; no ITW at disclosure but historical precedent demands emergency treatment; CERT-FR CERTFR-2026-AVI-0532.

items.title: Progress MOVEit Automation — authenticated privilege escalation (CVSS 8.8)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Chains with CVE-2026-4670 to yield fully unauthenticated administrative access to MOVEit Automation.

items.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.66 — HTTP/2 double-free RCE (CVSS 8.8)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Double-free in mod_http2 on early stream reset; DoS trivial, RCE requires APR mmap allocator (default Debian/Docker); PoC confirmed; fixed in Apache 2.4.67.

items.title: Traefik proxy — mTLS bypass via fragmented TLS ClientHello

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Fragmented TLS ClientHello causes SNI extraction failure, falling back to non-mTLS config; relevant to zero-trust API gateway deployments. CERT-FR CERTFR-2026-AVI-0531.

items.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.x — mod_proxy_ajp heap buffer overflow (RCE via AJP backend)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage (UPDATE to 2026-05-06 Apache item). mod_proxy_ajp heap buffer overflow via crafted AJP messages; fixed in Apache 2.4.67. Not retrieved in prior run.

items.title: Palo Alto PAN-OS Captive Portal — unauthenticated root RCE (CVSS 9.3, ITW, KEV deadline 2026-05-09)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Critical unauthenticated RCE in PAN-OS Captive Portal; CERT-EU Critical Advisory 2026-006; CISA KEV deadline 2026-05-09; exploitation since 2026-04-09 by CL-STA-1132 (likely state-sponsored); no patch until 2026-05-13. Deep dive § 5.
UPDATE: CISA KEV deadline is today (2026-05-09). No patch until 2026-05-13. Mitigation (disable Captive Portal or restrict to internal IPs) must be confirmed applied; treat as P0.

items.title: SimpleHelp RMM — missing authorisation privilege escalation (CVSS 9.9, ITW DragonForce/Medusa, KEV deadline 2026-05-08)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Low-privileged user escalates to server admin; chained with CVE-2024-57728 by DragonForce and Medusa ransomware targeting MSPs; CISA KEV deadline 2026-05-08 (overdue).

items.title: SimpleHelp RMM — path traversal / zip-slip code execution (CVSS 7.2, ITW, KEV deadline 2026-05-08)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Chained with CVE-2024-57726 to achieve code execution on SimpleHelp server via crafted zip upload; CISA KEV deadline 2026-05-08 (overdue).

items.title: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server — unauthenticated path traversal / file write (CVSS 9.8, Mirai, KEV deadline 2026-05-08)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Unauthenticated SYSTEM-level file write exploited to deploy Mirai botnet payloads; public-sector facilities (airports, hospitals) among deployment contexts; CISA KEV deadline 2026-05-08 (overdue).

items.title: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX — RadFilter deserialization RCE (CVSS 9.8)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Insecure deserialization RCE in RadFilter control; CERT-FR CERTFR-2026-AVI-0542; no confirmed active exploitation; fixed in 2026.1.421.

items.title: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX — RadAsyncUpload resource exhaustion DoS (CVSS 7.5)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Disk exhaustion via chunked upload bypassing file-size limits; CERT-FR CERTFR-2026-AVI-0542; fixed in 2026.1.421.

items.title: Zabbix monitoring platform — XSS / data confidentiality flaw (CERT-FR)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. XSS / data confidentiality in Zabbix 6.0.x/7.0.x/7.4.x; CERT-FR CERTFR-2026-AVI-0541; fixed in 6.0.45, 7.0.24, 7.4.8.

items.title: Zabbix monitoring platform — XSS / data confidentiality flaw (CERT-FR)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. See CVE-2026-23926 batch entry.

items.title: Zabbix monitoring platform — XSS / data confidentiality flaw (CERT-FR)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. See CVE-2026-23926 batch entry.

items.title: Metabase Enterprise — serialization import RCE (CVSS 7.2, public PoC)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Admin-authenticated RCE via POST /api/ee/serialization/import; public Python PoC released by Hakai Security; no KEV; fixed in patched versions. [SINGLE-SOURCE-OTHER]

items.title: ScarCruft (APT37 / Reaper) — North Korea-aligned APT

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Gaming platform supply-chain attack delivering BirdCall (Android, first documented) and RokRAT (Windows) targeting ethnic Korean diaspora in Yanbian, China.

items.title: BirdCall — ScarCruft Android/Windows backdoor

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. First documented Android instance; delivered via trojanized gaming platform; cloud-storage C2 (Zoho WorkDrive, pCloud, Yandex Disk); seven iterative Android versions tracked.

items.title: ShinyHunters — financially motivated data-theft group

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Claimed Instructure/Canvas breach (confirmed by victim); also claimed ADT breach vector (unconfirmed by victim); concurrent multi-target operation including Trellix and Medtronic claims.

items.title: TeamPCP — threat actor targeting software supply chains

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. SAP npm supply-chain worm (Mini Shai-Hulud) targeting developer environments and CI/CD pipelines; cloud credential harvesting; AI coding agent config weaponisation via .claude/settings.json.

items.title: Mini Shai-Hulud — TeamPCP SAP CAP npm supply-chain worm

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Four malicious SAP CAP npm packages published 2026-04-29; ~1,800 GitHub repos compromised within hours; self-propagating via stolen npm tokens; exfiltration via victim-owned GitHub repos.

items.title: UAT-8302 — China-nexus APT targeting government entities in South America and southeastern Europe

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Long-term government espionage; South American govts since late 2024; southeastern European govt agencies 2025; extensive toolset including NetDraft, CloudSorcerer, SNOWLIGHT, Deed RAT, Zingdoor, Draculoader; shared quartermaster links to multiple Chinese APT clusters.

items.title: World Leaks — rebranded Hunters International; data-theft extortion without encryption

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Rebranded from Hunters International (early 2025); data-theft only, no encryption; claimed 8.5 TB from Mediaworks Kft (Hungary, EU); victim confirmed incident.

items.title: France ANTS government identity agency breach — 11.7M citizen records confirmed

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Breach detected 2026-04-13; 12-18M citizen records (national IDs, names, DOB, emails); suspect (15 y/o) detained 2026-04-25; no confirmed technical vector; GDPR notification sent 2026-04-22 (9 days post-detection).
UPDATE: ANTS confirmed 11.7 million affected portal accounts, clarifying prior 12-18M range. Data categories and CNIL notification status unchanged.

items.title: DigiCert support portal compromise — 60 fraudulent EV code-signing certificates

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Social engineering via support chat (.scr file); two analyst endpoints infected; 12-day dwell due to absent EDR; 60 EV cert orders fraudulently generated; 11 used to sign Zhong Stealer malware.

items.title: Instructure (Canvas LMS) data breach — student and educator data

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Victim confirmed names, email addresses, student IDs, messages accessed; ShinyHunters claimed ~9,000 institutions affected (victim scale unconfirmed); API key revocation response.
UPDATE: Individual universities (U Nevada Reno, U Penn) issuing direct student/staff notifications from 2026-05-06. Institutional scale now surfacing in downstream disclosures.

UPDATE: Threat actor now claims 330 institutions across 6 countries; 44 Dutch institutions confirmed by SURF; 2026-05-12 extortion deadline; Canvas taken offline again 2026-05-07 for emergency patching; Dutch and German DPAs opened preliminary inquiries.

items.title: Trellix source code repository breach

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Victim confirmed portion of source code repository accessed; no confirmed impact on product distribution pipeline; vector, duration, and scope undisclosed.

items.title: ADT Inc. cloud environment breach — customer PII (SEC 8-K 2026-04-24)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Detected 2026-04-20; SEC 8-K filed 2026-04-24; names, phone, address; subset also DOB and last-4 SSN/TaxID; attacker-claimed vector (vishing → Okta SSO → Salesforce) unconfirmed by ADT.

items.title: Mediaworks Kft (Hungary) — World Leaks data-theft extortion

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. World Leaks (rebranded Hunters International) claimed 8.5 TB exfiltrated; Mediaworks (Hungarian EU-member media conglomerate) confirmed incident; no technical vector disclosed; GDPR notification status unknown.

items.title: Europol IOCTA 2026 — Internet Organised Crime Threat Assessment

appearances.delta_summary: First and only treatment. Key themes: state-criminal actor convergence, GenAI-enabled fraud at scale, ransomware data-exfiltration emphasis over encryption, public institutions as primary targets. Published 2026-04-28; included outside standard 72h window as first coverage.

items.title: DAEMON Tools supply chain compromise — China-nexus QUIC RAT via signed installers

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Disc Soft distribution server compromised 2026-04-08 to 2026-05-05; authentic Disc Soft code-signing cert maintained; three-stage payload (info collector + shellcode backdoor + QUIC RAT); ~12 targeted victims in government, scientific, manufacturing sectors; Germany, France, Italy in victim distribution; Chinese-speaking threat actor (unattributed); vendor confirmed and patched.

items.title: ChipSoft (Netherlands) healthcare software vendor — Embargo ransomware, 66 Dutch DPA notifications

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Attack 2026-04-07; HiX platform serves ~75% Dutch hospitals; Embargo group identified; 100 GB patient data claimed exfiltrated; attacker claims destruction (implies ransom paid); 66 Dutch DPA notifications; vendor confirmed incident.

items.title: Vimeo data breach via Anodot third-party SaaS compromise — 119,200 accounts

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Anodot credentials compromised; used to access Vimeo Snowflake/BigQuery environments; 119,200 email addresses and metadata exposed; ShinyHunters claimed; victim confirmed; published data after ransom declined.

items.title: Europol shadow IT systems — decade of unregulated data processing outside EU oversight

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Joint investigation (Correctiv/Solomon/Computer Weekly) reveals Europol CFN and Pressure Cooker systems held ≥2PB outside EU oversight; 32 security control deficiencies in 2019 internal assessment; EDPS notified 2026-04-01; 15 recommendations still unimplemented.

items.title: Mandiant M-Trends 2026 — Annual Threat Intelligence Report

appearances.delta_summary: First and only treatment. Published 2026-03-23; outside standard recency window; included as first coverage. Key findings: median dwell 14 days; espionage 122-day median; vishing surged to second-most-common initial access vector (11%); prior compromise as ransomware IAV doubled to 30%; edge-device persistence dominant for espionage; zero-day exploitation accelerating.

items.title: DragonForce — ransomware-as-a-service operator exploiting SimpleHelp RMM

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Weaponised CVE-2024-57726 and CVE-2024-57728 in SimpleHelp RMM to target MSPs; CISA KEV listing confirmed active exploitation.

items.title: Embargo — ransomware group; responsible for ChipSoft Netherlands attack

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Identified as responsible for ChipSoft April 2026 attack; claimed 100 GB patient data; asserted data destroyed after (implied) ransom payment.

items.title: OceanLotus (APT32) — Vietnam-nexus APT; PyPI supply chain campaign

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. PyPI supply chain campaign since July 2025; ZiChatBot delivered via fake utility packages; Zulip API used for C2; 64% algorithmic similarity to prior OceanLotus dropper. [SINGLE-SOURCE-OTHER]

items.title: CL-STA-1132 — likely state-sponsored exploitation cluster for CVE-2026-0300 (PAN-OS)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Unit 42 tracking cluster; exploitation began 2026-04-09; post-exploitation includes nginx injection, credential theft, EarthWorm/ReverseSocks5 tunneling, AD enumeration; medium confidence state-sponsored attribution.

items.title: QLNX (Quasar Linux) — developer-targeting Linux RAT with eBPF rootkit and PAM backdoor

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Fileless execution; dynamic LD_PRELOAD and eBPF rootkit compilation on victim; PAM credential harvesting; developer credential harvesting (npm, PyPI, GitHub, cloud providers); supply-chain pivot design.

items.title: ZiChatBot — OceanLotus PyPI supply chain backdoor using Zulip API C2

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Delivered via malicious PyPI packages; Zulip REST API as C2 channel; Windows and Linux variants; persistence via Registry/crontab. [SINGLE-SOURCE-OTHER]

items.title: Amatera — InstallFix campaign infostealer targeting browser credentials and e-wallets

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Distributed via malvertised fake AI tool installation pages; mshta.exe delivery, AMSI bypass; harvests browser credentials, session cookies, e-wallet data; Netherlands government sector in victim telemetry.

items.title: InstallFix — malvertising campaign distributing Amatera infostealer via fake AI tool install pages

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Active since March 2026; malvertised Google Ads for AI coding tool searches; Netherlands government sector explicitly targeted; polyglot ZIP/HTA delivery; AMSI bypass via RC4-decrypted strings.

items.title: Ivanti EPMM on-prem — pre-auth certificate impersonation (CVSS 9.1, ITW, KEV chain with CVE-2026-6973)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. CWE-295; unauthenticated attacker impersonates Sentry host registration to obtain valid CA-signed client certificate; chains with CVE-2026-6973 for pre-auth RCE. Fixed in 12.6.1.1/12.7.0.1/12.8.0.1. Deep dive § 7.

items.title: Ivanti EPMM on-prem — admin API improper input validation → RCE (CVSS 7.2, ITW, KEV deadline 2026-05-10)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. CWE-20; chained with CVE-2026-5787 for fully pre-auth RCE. CISA KEV deadline 2026-05-10. ~508 EU internet-reachable on-prem instances. Fixed in 12.6.1.1/12.7.0.1/12.8.0.1. Deep dive § 7.

items.title: Windows Shell protection mechanism failure — NTLM coercion / spoofing (CVSS 4.3, APT28 ITW, KEV deadline 2026-05-12)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. CWE-693; crafted LNK/Shell artefact coerces NTLM authentication to attacker-controlled server; APT28 actively exploiting against EU government ministries. CISA KEV deadline 2026-05-12. Fixed in April 2026 Patch Tuesday.
First coverage (batch with GLPI CERTFR-2026-AVI-0551). SSRF; no ITW; fix in GLPI ≥ 10.0.25 / ≥ 11.0.7.

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage (batch with GLPI CERTFR-2026-AVI-0551). XSS; no ITW; fix in ≥ 10.0.25 / ≥ 11.0.7.

items.title: GLPI < 10.0.25 / 11.0.7 — security policy bypass / auth bypass (CERTFR-2026-AVI-0551)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage (batch with GLPI CERTFR-2026-AVI-0551). Security policy bypass; no ITW.

items.title: Pro-Russian hacktivist OT intrusion at five Polish water treatment facilities — pump settings modified

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. ABW advisory. Five water treatment OT networks compromised; pump control settings modified; manual override prevented service disruption. Attribution: pro-Russian hacktivists, pattern consistent with NoName057(16)/Cyber Army of Russia Reborn. [SINGLE-SOURCE-NATIONAL-CERT]

items.title: MuddyWater (Iran/MOIS) Chaos ransomware false-flag + Teams credential harvesting — Europe/Middle East

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Chaos ransomware as attribution false-flag; Teams social engineering for credential harvesting (T1566.004); targeting government contractors and defence-adjacent orgs in Europe and Middle East. [SINGLE-SOURCE-OTHER]

items.title: Die Linke (Germany) — Qilin ransomware, 1.5 TB claimed, DPA notified (April 2026)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage (~4 weeks old; first coverage in brief series). Qilin RaaS; 1.5 TB claimed; DPA notification confirmed; victim statement issued. First-coverage recency note in brief.

items.title: Eurail breach (December 2025) — 308 777 travellers notified April 2026; Dutch DPA and EDPS reviewing delayed notification

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Breach December 2025; notifications began April 2026 (3-month delay). Data: passport numbers, IBANs, DiscoverEU pass data; 308 777 affected. Dutch DPA (AP) and EDPS opened reviews. GDPR Article 33 72h notification rule implicated.

items.title: CERT-FR CERTFR-2026-ACT-016 — Agentic AI tool risks: prompt injection, MCP supply chain, sandboxing

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. CERT-FR advisory on agentic AI risks: prompt injection via processed docs, MCP server supply-chain, insufficient sandbox. [SINGLE-SOURCE-NATIONAL-CERT]

items.title: Dragos 2025 OT Cybersecurity Year in Review — Frontlines IR Edition

appearances.delta_summary: First and only treatment. 81% flat IT/OT architecture in IR engagements; 62% initial access via internet-exposed remote access; 34% intrusions reached operational process level; NIS2 compliance gaps identified. [SINGLE-SOURCE-OTHER]

items.title: Kaspersky Q1 2026 Exploits and Vulnerabilities Report

appearances.delta_summary: First and only treatment. Document-based exploit resurgence; Office Protected View bypass dominant Q1 2026; +34% browser exploitation QoQ; RaaS groups acquiring zero-days directly from brokers. [SINGLE-SOURCE-OTHER]

items.title: Amazon SES abuse for authenticated BEC/phishing (Kaspersky, 2026-05-04)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage (96h old at publication; outside 72h window but first coverage). SES API credentials harvested from misconfigured S3/GitHub; SPF/DKIM pass; targets European finance/manufacturing; BEC and credential phishing. [SINGLE-SOURCE-OTHER]
